blockers.details: Ready for normalization planning, not runtime import.
Runtime import still needs an explicit import task, geometry implementation and visual QA.
Boundary-sensitive rules require GIS overlays against final normalized geometry.
Cabin availability/fees, water reliability/quality, KLT/Närtrafik, fire risk, hunting signs/notices, forestry and route passability are publication-time checks.

openDecisions.decision: Decide whether runtime import should include a separately sourced access leg from Etapp 8 official GPX end to the Lilla Hycklinge cabin, or keep the 156.4 m gap as metadata only.
openDecisions.whyItMatters: The normalization plan keeps the official GPX endpoint to close the digital ring and treats the cabin marker as endpoint facility/access metadata unless a sourced access leg is approved.

openDecisions.decision: Decide whether optional narrative POIs and approximate swim/access points should be included in the first runtime import or left pending.
openDecisions.whyItMatters: Many are useful but lack exact coordinates or require side-service/access modeling.

openDecisions.decision: Approve candidate-only geometry normalization prototype before any shared runtime source data is touched.
openDecisions.whyItMatters: The existing plan explicitly says to prototype and QA under candidate research first.

validationChecklist: JSON parse this handoff and every changed research file.
Confirm normalization-plan.research.json remains the controlling detailed plan.
Verify all 8 section files exist and match sectionCoverage.sectionIds.
Implement candidate-only geometry transforms with raw source URL, transform instruction, computed length, display distance and endpoint gap metadata.
Run visual QA against official PDF/map viewer for repaired multi-track sections.
Confirm Etapp 8 closes the digital ring at the official GPX endpoint and does not silently snap to Lilla Hycklinge cabin.
Review duplicate endpoint cabin/toilet/well/parking records before import rows.
Run GIS overlays for all ruleWarningPlan.requiresGisOverlayBeforeRuleImport entries before static rule import.
Recheck fire bans, KLT/Närtrafik, cabin availability/fees, water, hunting signs/notices and forestry/passability before runtime publication.
Keep all outputs research-only until the user explicitly requests runtime integration.
